original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 fixes a bug where string array elements were not parsed correctly in JSON processing.

decision.reason: [ev-baf37887295d] lists this as a bug fix: string array elements were not being parsed correctly in JSON processing. Configuration stays the same and only the parsing semantics change, so behavior-changed is the right type. Of the families on offer, protocol-behavior fits this runtime parsing behaviour best. The name json-string-array-parsing is kebab-case built only from the evidence's own key words.
